papers.title_en: APEX: Asynchronous Prefix Denoising for Extreme Compression
papers.authors: David Dinkevich, Nisan Chiprut, Yoav HaCohen, Dani Lischinski
papers.evidence: 面向极致图像压缩的层次潜空间自编码器
papers.tldr: 扩散模型可用更少 latent token 降低开销，但极端压缩面临重建-生成两难：增加通道提升重建却使生成更难。APEX 将分层 latent 空间与按通道组的异步去噪结合，自编码器按结构到细节排序通道前缀，共享去噪器以错开局部时间生成各前缀，且不增加 token。在 ImageNet-512 上，64x 与 128x 压缩下各通道数均优于现有方法；匹配训练和引导采样计算时，各预算均超 256-token 模型，低计算收益更大。该工作为极端压缩扩散提供了高效生成范式。
papers.abstract_en: Fewer latent tokens promise cheaper diffusion. Yet aggressive latent compression creates a reconstruction-generation dilemma: adding channels improves reconstruction but makes generation harder. We introduce APEX, short for Asynchronous Prefix denoising for EXtreme compression, which pairs a hierarchical latent space with asynchronous denoising over channel groups. Our autoencoder orders channel prefixes from structure to detail, while one shared denoiser generates them at staggered local times without adding tokens. On ImageNet-512, APEX outperforms existing methods at every evaluated channel count under 64x and 128x compression. At matched training and guided sampling compute, it also outperforms a 256-token model at every evaluated budget, with larger gains at lower compute. Code is available at https://daviddinkevich.github.io/APEX.

papers.title_en: Unified Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Tianyu Zhang, Shuai Huo, Dengchao Jin, Hewei Liu, Meng Lei, Tianwen Wu, Jiawen Gu, Chao Zhou, Li Li, Dong Liu
papers.evidence: 超低码率学习式视频压缩，与压缩主题相关
papers.tldr: 视频扩散模型可在超低码率下重建高质量视频，但双向（BI）模型需完整序列、延迟高，自回归（AR）模型适合低延迟流式却压缩效率受限。为此提出UniGVC，统一生成式视频编解码器，同一比特流支持两种解码：BI用稠密注意力实现高质量随机访问，AR用窗口化AR-DiT实现低延迟流式；二者共享分层隐式编解码器，并以BI作教师对AR单步蒸馏。1080p上，BI率-失真-感知权衡最佳，码率仅0.0005bpp；AR达36.85FPS，比BI快250倍。
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models can reconstruct visually compelling content from severely compressed representations at ultra-low bitrates, but they impose a rigid deployment trade-off. Bidirectional (BI) models achieve high quality through dense full-sequence attention, yet require the entire sequence before reconstruction and incur substantial latency. Autoregressive (AR) models enable low-delay streaming, but their restricted temporal context reduces compression efficiency. This tension is particularly relevant when a video stream must be decoded in real time yet is also stored for later, quality-oriented playback, making AR and BI models natural choices for the live and replay stages, respectively. To support both stages, we present UniGVC, a Unified Generative Video Codec that supports two decoding modes from a single bitstream. UniGVC-BI employs a BI-DiT with dense attention for quality-oriented random-access decoding, whereas UniGVC-AR uses windowed AR-DiT for low-delay streaming. Both paths share a hierarchical latent codec that recurrently produces the same conditions with ultra-low bitrates, allowing UniGVC-BI to serve as a conditional teacher for single-step distillation of UniGVC-AR. A tiny conditional video decoder further reduces streaming latency while preserving most of the reconstruction quality. On standard 1080p benchmarks, UniGVC-BI achieves the best overall rate-distortion-perception trade-off among the evaluated methods and produces temporally stable video at rates as low as 0.0005 bits per pixel. Meanwhile, UniGVC-AR remains competitive while decoding 1080p video at 36.85 FPS, over $250\times$ faster than UniGVC-BI. Code and models will be released later.

papers.title_en: Goal-Oriented Ordered Autoencoding for Successive Refinement in Progressive Communication
papers.evidence: 以失真为优化目标的量化隐自编码
papers.tldr: 面向目标通信在可变带宽下难以维持下游任务性能。GO-OAE学习可渐进细化的量化潜序列，并按任务效用而非源重建优化，接收任意索引前缀即可推理。理论上等价于加权条件信息瓶颈，并用MPIS将训练复杂度从O(BK)降至O(Bm)。在MiniImageNet上以324比特达无损上界96%以上，仅传70%索引仍有94%上界，验证极端压缩下的渐进通信。
papers.abstract_en: Goal-oriented communication often struggles to sustain downstream task performance under variable and unpredictable bandwidth. We address this problem by proposing GO-OAE (Goal-Oriented Ordered AutoEncoding), which learns a progressively refinable quantized latent sequence, optimized directly for task utility rather than source reconstruction. Each component of the sequence is represented for transmission by its code index, and the learned ordering enables inference from any received prefix of the index sequence, with performance improving as more indices arrive. We prove that optimizing the goal-oriented distortion objective is equivalent to solving a weighted conditional information bottleneck formulation, and introduce an unbiased multi-prefix importance sampling (MPIS) estimator, to reduce GO-OAE training computational cost from O(BK) to O(Bm) with m << K, and reduces the estimator variance by a factor of 1/m. Experiments show that, on MiniImageNet, GO-OAE achieves over 96% of the lossless upper-bound classification accuracy using 324 bits per image (683X compression vs. raw RGB), and already attains over 94% of the upper bound with only 70% of the transmitted indices. It consistently outperforms reconstruction-optimized codecs and ordered autoencoders trained with uniform prefix sampling across all transmission budgets, demonstrating effective communication at extreme compression rates.

papers.authors: Xiaohan Qin, Xiangdong Zhang, Tuo Dai, Sunan Zou, Huaijin Wu, Yebin Yang, Zhuo Xia, Lin Yao, Yuliang Liu, Junchi Yan
papers.evidence: 新的深度注意力架构以低开销提升性能
papers.tldr: 残差连接难以按内容检索网络各深度的历史表征，AttnRes 将其视为沿深度轴的单流注意力。MSAR 把该机制推广为多头深度注意力：用多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文构造流的多样性，再以轻量自适应混合还原单流层输入，无需持久多流存储或通信。在 18B 与 28B MoE 的 12 项下游基准上均优于标准残差、mHC 与 AttnRes，缩放律实验取得 1.58× 等损失算力加速。
papers.abstract_en: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.

papers.title_en: State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.authors: Yan Luo, Laibin Chang, Zefan Feng, Yi'ang Chen, Kui Jiang, Zhengguo Li
papers.evidence: 状态隔离的Vision Mamba架构改进
papers.tldr: Vision Mamba 通过循环状态建模长程依赖，但现有方法多关注 token 序列化与扫描，忽略循环状态组织方式。本文指出异质更新 token 共享同一隐状态会引发状态竞争，并提出状态隔离原则：按更新倾向兼容性组织状态演化。为此设计 IsoMamba，以 Δ 引导、无标签聚类发现兼容 token 组，并路由至隔离的 Mamba 专家，同时引入动态通道重加权。实验表明，该方法在水下图像增强多个基准上取得最优性能，且隐状态响应更干净。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.

papers.title_en: MemFLoRA: Memory-Floor LoRA for CNN Adaptation at the Edge
papers.authors: Mehmet Emre Akbulut, Johannes Geier, Ulf Schlichtmann
papers.evidence: 面向CNN端侧适配的低秩LoRA适配器，降低激活内存
papers.tldr: 边缘CNN部署后常遇用户、传感器或环境漂移，需要端侧学习，但PEFT的瓶颈常不是可训练参数，而是反向传播前需保存的激活内存。MemFLoRA以内存优先设计CNN低秩适配器：冻结下投影，训练尺度匹配上投影，并用评估模式归一化与激活最小化反向规则，将保存状态限于低秩分支。在3个HAR数据集、2个CNN骨干和多种偏移下，其激活内存减少98.5-98.7%，峰值训练状态内存降低94.9-97.3%，性能匹配或超越CNN PEFT基线。
papers.abstract_en: On-device learning is necessary when the model encounters user-,sensor-, or environment-specific shifts after deployment. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, particularly Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) variants, enable efficient adaptation at the edge, the limiting resource for Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) adaptation is often not the number of trainable parameters but the activation state that must be retained until the backward pass. This paper introduces Memory-Floor LoRA (MemFLoRA), a low-rank CNN adapter built around a memory-first design principle rather than a direct application of transformer-oriented LoRA. Instead of merely reducing trainable weights, we define an activation-memory-floor criterion: trainable backward computations must not depend on full-width layer inputs. The resulting adapter freezes the down-projection, trains a scale-matched up-projection, and combines eval-mode backbone normalization with activation-minimal backward rules, reducing saved state to the low-rank branch. Evaluated on three Human Activity Recognition (HAR) datasets and two CNN backbones under subject, body-location, and sensor-placement shifts, MemFLoRA reduces saved-activation memory by 98.5-98.7% and peak training-state memory by 94.9-97.3% relative to full fine-tuning, while matching or exceeding CNN PEFT baselines.

papers.title_en: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
papers.authors: Hao Jiang, Yiru Mao, Tianpeng Bu, Hao Zhou, Hongtao Duan, Wang Jing, Bowen Xu, Xin Chen, Lulu Hu, Bin Yang, Yongliang Tao, Minying Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于线性注意力的视觉Token压缩以提升效率
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型性能出色，但视觉token主导输入、计算开销沉重，压缩视觉token至关重要；而线性注意力架构（如Qwen3.5）兴起后，面向softmax注意力的旧压缩方法明显失效。为此提出免训练框架V-CoLA：以唯一性感知重要性准则筛选关键视觉token，再用自适应合并策略压缩，并适配线性注意力的分块并行。实验表明仅保留50.0%视觉token即可达99.5%原性能，12.5%时仍超88.0%，预填充加速1.86×至6.15×。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose \textbf{V-CoLA}, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel \textit{uniqueness-aware importance criterion} for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an \textit{adaptive token merging strategy} that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86$\times$ to 6.15$\times$ prefill speedup.

papers.title_en: Neural Polar Codes for Source Coding
papers.authors: Bashar Huleihel, Ziv Aharoni, Haim H. Permuter
papers.evidence: 面向数据驱动信源压缩的神经极化码
papers.tldr: 传统极码源编码对未知q元有记忆源依赖显式模型，SC解码计算昂贵。本文提出神经极码解码器，直接从数据学习合成极坐标的条件分布，并给出解析SC递推及复杂度分析。该方法可用于估计熵率、互信息与率失真函数，并构建无损、有损及Wyner-Ziv压缩方案。实验在无记忆、有记忆源和真实基因组数据上逼近解析SC，且在传统方法不可行时仍适用。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a data-driven approach to lossless and lossy source compression using polar codes. Classical polar source coding achieves fundamental limits with low complexity for binary memoryless sources. However, for unknown q-ary sources with memory, successive-cancellation (SC) decoding requires an explicit source model and can be computationally prohibitive. We present analytical SC recursions and show that exact implementations scale quadratically with alphabet size and cubically with state-space size. To overcome these limitations, we develop neural polar decoders trained directly from data to approximate conditional distributions of synthetic polar coordinates without requiring an explicit source model. These learned distributions enable estimation of entropy rates, mutual information, and rate-distortion functions, and support explicit polar compression schemes. For lossless compression, we identify high-entropy polarized coordinates and reconstruct the remaining coordinates using the learned SC recursion. For lossy compression, we combine neural polar decoders with a neural test channel to estimate and optimize the mutual information-distortion tradeoff and construct an explicit lossy polar code. We also extend the framework to Wyner-Ziv compression with decoder side information by learning conditional polarized distributions and a reconstruction mapping. Experiments on memoryless sources, sources with memory, and real genomic data show that the learned decoders closely match analytical SC decoders when available and remain applicable when conventional methods are computationally infeasible or the source model is unavailable.

papers.title_en: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration
papers.authors: Yucheng Xin, Runci Bai, Yongcong Wang, Guangwei Gao, Jiao Liu, Dianjie Lu, Linwei Fan, Zhuoran Zheng
papers.evidence: 面向图像与视频复原的循环式混合专家架构
papers.tldr: 统一超高清视频复原常靠加深网络提升泛化，但收益有限且参数膨胀。本文提出LoopMoEVR，将循环学习与退化感知混合专家结合，用退化条件低秩循环嵌入、IterAda3DN时空迭代自适应归一化和专家分支生成调制参数，并由深度预测器自适应决定循环次数。模型仅约0.884M可训练参数，统一处理UHD视频去雾、去雨、去噪与低光增强，在公开基准和真实场景取得SOTA。该工作表明循环MoE能以极低参数实现跨域UHD视频复原。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, unified high-definition image restoration has attracted considerable attention; however, existing models tend to excessively increase their depth in pursuit of improved generalization, which often yields only limited gains. Meanwhile, loop-based learning paradigms have drawn widespread attention due to their low parameter counts and strong regression capability, as exemplified by GPT-6 and looped Transformers. In this paper, we introduce the loop learning paradigm to address restoration tasks that require cross-domain learning. Specifically, we propose LoopMoEVR, a loop-based mixture-of-experts model capable of handling degraded ultra-high-definition (UHD) inputs. First, a degradation-conditioned low-rank loop embedding is designed to construct input-dependent stage conditions. Second, a spatio-temporal iterative adaptive normalization module, termed IterAda3DN, is developed to fuse local features with global loop context, thereby performing position-wise affine modulation. Finally, the expert branches further integrate the attention-updated local and global video states with the loop conditions to generate dedicated modulation parameters, while an input-conditioned depth predictor adaptively configures the number of loop iterations. With only approximately 0.884M trainable parameters, the proposed model uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks, achieving state-of-the-art restoration performance on both public benchmarks and real-world scenarios.

papers.title_en: RefRoute: Decoupling Conditioning Cost from References via Compact Residual Conditioning and Spatial Routing
papers.authors: Wanning He, Yuyao Zhang, Yu-Wing Tai
papers.evidence: 面向扩散Transformer的高效条件与注意力设计
papers.tldr: 多参考图像生成需保持多主体外观并组合成连贯场景，但现有扩散Transformer把参考编码为稠密视觉token网格并用全局注意力联合处理，参考数量与分辨率增长时开销急剧上升。RefRoute通过紧凑残差条件将低分辨率隐token与全分辨率像素残差特征结合，并以条件路由与注意力路由对齐参考与目标区域、限制跨参考交互。在ManyRef100上Weighted-Ref-VIEScore达36.06（FLUX.2-Klein-9B为8.88），16参考时50步与4步配置分别加速18.3倍和14.2倍。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-reference image generation requires preserving the appearance of multiple subjects while composing them into a coherent scene. However, existing diffusion transformers commonly encode references as dense visual token grids and jointly process them with global attention, making conditioning increasingly expensive as the number and resolution of references grow. We present RefRoute, a framework that addresses both reference representation cost and attention overhead through two complementary mechanisms. Compact residual conditioning combines low-resolution latent tokens with lightweight residual features extracted from full-resolution pixels, reducing reference token counts while retaining fine-grained appearance cues. Condition routing and attention routing align reference tokens with their assigned target regions and restrict cross-reference interactions, while allowing selective reference access beyond region boundaries for scene integration. We further introduce RefRoute-Data for training many-reference generation models and ManyRef100, a benchmark spanning human, object, and mixed compositions with 10-17 references. After many-reference fine-tuning, RefRoute achieves an overall Weighted-Ref-VIEScore of 36.06 on ManyRef100, compared with 8.88 for FLUX.2-Klein-9B. Separate inference-cost evaluations show substantially slower latency growth as the reference count increases: at 16 references, our 50-step and 4-step configurations achieve $18.3\times$ and $14.2\times$ speedups over their corresponding FLUX baselines, respectively. These results establish compact reference representations and spatially routed attention as an effective approach to scalable many-reference image generation.

papers.title_en: TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation
papers.authors: Eliyahu Levy, Adam Teman, Yoni Pugachov
papers.evidence: 针对量化误差来源的后训练量化方法
papers.tldr: Transformer 后训练量化虽能高效部署，却受限于非线性层，现有方法常归因于数值精度不足并依赖浮点回退。TR-PTQ 指出归一化层可学习缩放与 GELU 复合近似才是主要误差源，而 SoftMax 对激进量化较稳健。其统一纯整数公式以共享 Taylor Region 指数/对数原语，将对数域中的除法与开方等运算转为整数算术，并用免校准、离群值感知的 LayerNorm 参数优化消除非线性浮点单元。在视觉与语言基准上绝对精度损失低于 1.5%，实现高精度纯整数量化。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.

papers.title_en: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
papers.authors: Jiyoung Kim, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Jisu Nam, Donghoon Lee, Hyunsung Go, Yeonkyeong Lee, Hansaem Kim, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 用视频自编码器做潜变量压缩以加速生成
papers.tldr: 高压缩视频自编码器可减少DiT token并加速视频扩散，但压缩会损害重建质量并需更多通道，且潜在分布偏离预训练DiT，导致重训或适配成本高。GRACE提出两阶段框架：保留冻结的预训练基础潜变量，学习残差潜变量补偿压缩损失，并在冻结DiT特征空间中对齐压缩潜变量，使自编码器面向生成优化。随后用轻量微调与非对称去噪适配DiT，让基础先于残差去噪。在Wan2.1-I2V-14B上，GRACE将token数减少8倍、延迟降低11.1倍，并在VBench上保持原管线生成质量。
papers.abstract_en: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.

papers.title_en: Dynamics as Code: On Model Compression via Dynamic System
papers.authors: Fan Gao, Wei Su, Juntong Fan, Renfeng Peng, Hongyu Liu, Jinqiao Duan, Feng-Lei Fan
papers.evidence: 通过动态系统权重表示实现预训练网络模型压缩
papers.tldr: 预训练模型规模激增，部署受内存与算力限制，模型压缩成为前提。本文把压缩重新定义为动态系统轨迹索引编码：高维权重由轨迹状态索引表示，解压时恢复向量，区别于剪枝、量化、蒸馏与低秩分解。作者证明在丢番图条件下，无理缠绕的有限轨迹可构成权重空间的ε-net，并统一四类动态系统压缩框架。实验在 ResNet-18 与 Qwen 系列上取得有竞争力压缩比，无需事后重训练且误差可控。
papers.abstract_en: The escalating size of pretrained neural networks has rendered model compression a prerequisite for deployment under stringent memory and compute constraints. With the irrational winding as an example, earlier work introduced a dynamic system (DS) paradigm that reconceptualizes compression as compact weight representation: high-dimensional parameters are encoded by the index of a trajectory produced by a dynamic system, from which the vector is recovered during decompression. This mechanism is fundamentally distinct from pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and low-rank decomposition. Along this direction, we prove that under a Diophantine condition, a finite trajectory of \(M = O(ε^{-(d+ν)})\) states in the irrational winding constitutes an \(ε\)-net over the \(d\)-dimensional weight space, thereby linking state resolution, decompression error, and compression ratio in a predictable manner. Furthermore, we propose a generalized DS-based model compression framework by unifying four DS families---space-filling curves (Hilbert, Peano, Morton/Z-order, Snake), chaotic systems (Lorenz), congruential and pseudo-random generators (LCG, PCG), and low-discrepancy sequences (Halton). Also, we introduce the KD-tree and coordinate-template acceleration to scale to large models as well as outlier identification to control the error. Experiments on ResNet-18 and Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B validate that DS-based compression achieves competitive compression ratios without post-hoc retraining, with controllable decompression error and flexible state-space design, establishing it as a principled and practical compression approach.

papers.title_en: iCATS: Fast Video Generation via Interaction-Aware Sparse Attention and Timestep-Adaptive Sparsity
papers.authors: Chengfeng Han, Baole Ai, Xianlu Bian, Jie Yao, Zilong Huang, Ang Wang, Dandan Ding
papers.evidence: 改进扩散Transformer性能的高效稀疏注意力
papers.tldr: 免训练稀疏注意力能降低 Diffusion Transformers 视频生成计算量，但重要性估计与稀疏掩码会带来近似误差，导致生成质量下降。iCATS 提出基于 query-key 点积交互的聚类重要性估计，将其转化为低成本二次型计算；同时设计 SNR 引导的稀疏度调度，按去噪时间步动态调整稀疏程度，并用尾部合并策略减少不规则簇导致的填充开销。在 HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B 上，iCATS 取得 2.03 倍加速与 31.017 dB PSNR；在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上取得 1.55 倍加速与 29.301 dB PSNR，实现领先的效率-质量权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Training-free sparse attention offers a practical acceleration solution to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) via reducing computations without fine-tuning. It typically involves estimating the importance of query-key regions and deriving sparse masks to compute only the important candidates, which inevitably introduces approximation errors that may degrade generation quality. To better balance the efficiency-quality trade-off, we propose iCATS, integrating improved importance estimation and sparse mask construction with an efficient hardware execution strategy. Specifically, for importance estimation, unlike previous works that perform independent clustering over query and key tokens based on feature similarity to estimate attention scores, iCATS demonstrates that clustering based on query-key dot-product interactions is more accurate and further reformulates this objective as a simple quadratic form for low-cost computation. For sparse mask construction, instead of using a fixed top-p rule, we observe that tolerance to sparse approximation errors varies across denoising timesteps and therefore introduce an SNR-guided sparsity schedule to adjust sparsity dynamically, leading to higher accuracy. Finally, for hardware execution, we devise a tail-merging strategy to reduce padding overhead caused by irregular cluster sizes, improving GPU kernel utilization. Extensive experiments show that iCATS achieves $2.03\times$ acceleration with 31.017 dB PSNR on HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B and $1.55\times$ acceleration with 29.301 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V-14B, delivering a state-of-the-art efficiency-quality trade-off.
